spec_case: issue #591: the agent tool reads params.prompt from a file named in state
description: `provider: agent` with `params.prompt: {file: {from: ...}, within: ...}` reads the file when the effect dispatches and sends its text verbatim to the session (the fake replies with its SHA-256 and length, never the text); `meta.template_files` records it and `meta.params_rendered.prompt` keeps the `{file, within}` form with the resolved path. Each error (no such file, outside `within`, not UTF-8) and a `params_json` that sets the form at dispatch fail their effect, and `on_error: continue` goes on. The session's transcript goes to a scratch directory the last effect removes. Python only: electricity refuses the cof-only agent plugin.
